summary: This Christmas sermon teaches that Jesus was the most joyful person to ever live and calls believers to cultivate joy as an act of defiance against a broken world. Joy is not pretending problems don't exist, but choosing to view circumstances through the lens of God's sovereignty and eternal perspective.
key_points: Jesus was profoundly joyful—healing brought delight, children loved him, he feasted often
Joy is an act of defiance in a world that profits from fear
Believers must live in tension: the world is broken but God has triumphed
Practical steps: set your mind on joy, surrender control, pray daily, focus on good
Like GPS recalculating, respond to life's detours with trust instead of panic
big_idea: Jesus, the most joyful person to walk the earth, calls his followers to choose joy as an act of defiance by trusting God's sovereignty even in broken circumstances.
